slicer: lang_code=ru; pos not ending in 'redirect'; headword normalizes to a lowercase single-token Cyrillic word without 'ъ' (internal hyphens kept); entries tagged proper-noun/surname/given-name/patronymic/toponym/place-name/ethnonym or archaic/obsolete/historical/dated/dialect(al) are refused; at most 3 sense glosses (first per sense), whitespace-collapsed, truncated to 200 chars on a word boundary; inflected Cyrillic surfaces (no 'ъ') kept as lookup forms (dedup, sorted, cap 12); homographs merged; rows sorted by headword UTF-8 byte order
note: The raw kaikki input is not committed (size); --check proves the committed slice matches this pinned sha256 and its own shape. Re-running --write on the pinned input is byte-identical.
